notes: A–I are BellSync identifiers for the nine source columns, not official room numbers. Source: 2026–27 main classroom schedule.

The source time row at 1:00–1:05 PM is malformed. That interval is unconfirmed and stays blank. The following activity is shown only for its confirmed 1:05–1:30 PM portion; its original start is not asserted.
Bathroom entries are point reminders from the workbook, not timed activities. Missing entries remain unset. Afternoon 1:xx entries are interpreted in school-day order.
KidzFun dates have no stated year. They fit Wednesdays in 2026–27 but are not confirmed for this year, so no KidzFun events are scheduled.
The main classroom schedule takes precedence over conflicting playground allocations. Extra front-playground, indoor-recess and specialist slots are not inserted.
Dismissal is the published student-dismissal activity, not a confirmed teacher departure. No later duties or workday end are supplied.
Early-release activity times are unavailable. Planned PreK last day: June 15, 2027, without snow days; no extension is assumed. September 24 Back to School Night has no supplied time.
Your saved copy can be renamed. Shared schedule titles use this neutral classroom label; your local nickname is not exported.
G and H have matching classroom activities. Use their distinct bathroom reminders to identify your choice: G begins at 9:50 AM; H at 10:55 AM.
